facts.fact: The Agence mauritanienne d'information reports that seven members of Mauritania's personal data protection authority took the legal oath in Nouakchott on 22 February 2024 before taking up their posts, under Article 70 of Law No. 020/2017 of 22 July 2017.

facts.fact: The Agence mauritanienne d'information reports that members of the data protection authority were sworn on 22 February 2024 under Law No. 020/2017 of 22 July 2017 on personal data protection, which sets the authority's missions, composition and appointment.
Seven members of the authority took the oath on 22 February 2024 before entering office.
